scene knifeboy1
Sana Sakakibara was out for a late night stroll.
It was a thing she did sometimes when it was hard for her to sleep.
It never made her tired or anything of the sort. In fact, I’d say it did the opposite.
But I guess there’s no reason for you to trust my word when you don’t even know who I am.
Regardless, here she was, retracing the same steps as always in a lap around a block she’d never visited in the daytime.
But something about the way it looked at night excited her, so she kept coming back.
The dark alleys and how those gaping mouths of black would unsuccessfully beckon her in — the overwhelming silence that made her footsteps echo throughout those moonlit, concrete caverns.
She gazed down at her phone, her thumb darting up and down and up and down as she tried to come up with an excuse as to why she’d call a certain someone at a certain time of night.
She never did, though.
She’d gone through the trouble of asking her roommate for his number, but the only time she ever got any use out of it was during a desperate plea for him to come and quell her hormones.
It wasn’t always like this, though. There wasn’t always indecision or curiosity or excitement.
But there was always fear.
A long, long time ago — she was normal.
But the night’s infinite reach claimed her heart and put an end to that innocence from miles away in a place just like this one.
It was that thought that made it impossible to be comforted here. It was that thought that prevented her from ever getting tired no matter how far she walked.
She taps on his name.
scene knifeboy2
She changes her mind.
She taps it again.
She changes her mind again.
It was like a one-sided game of phone tag where she was never it.
But she would be one day. And that day couldn’t come soon enough.
scene knifeboy3
She looks up at the top of the tallest building on the block, wondering how long it would take to fall from its peak to the ground below.
She didn’t want to die. She just wanted to know what death felt like. She wanted to know if there really was an afterlife or if everything just went dark.
: Psst...
scene knifeboy4
It was a reasonable thought everyone has from time to time.
scene knifeboy5
It was only exacerbated by what she saw next.
scene knifeboy6
: Wha-
: They say my limbs are long enough to reach the sky and back.
: What do you think about that?
: I have seen you before.
: You wander these streets with that block in your hand.
: You always look delicious.
: Who is it you think of when the glow hits your face?
scene knifeboy7
: Oh no...
: It’s happening again...
Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara. Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara?
: They call me the tree tickler. My fingers are perfect for that sort of thing.
: Go away.
: Perhaps you’d like to feel their sting?
: You aren’t real...
: This isn’t actually happening...
scene knifeboy8
: I’m as real as rhubarb. I come bearing gifts.
: A palace, a portal, five bundles of sticks.
: Won’t you enter my alley? I think we’d be fast friends.
scene knifeboy9
: Ngh! Stop! Go...AWaY!!!
Her finger presses her temple presses her temple presses her temple because that sort of thing helps with headaches.
Things that don’t belong suddenly do. And things that do suddenly don’t.
Remember the rabbits. Remember his chest. Remember his heartbeat and and and remember the REST SANA should be in BED
: I have just the thing for that. A medicine that cures. Every sorrowful thought you ever did think, it’s a drink to make you pure.
: Won’t you enter my alley? I think we’d be fast friends.
: I have to...call someone! Before I...ngh!
Her head hurt. That’s what all of the “ngh”s were about.
GODNOTE: NGH stands for New Generational Height — the place she would soon reach.
To the sky and back she flew.
scene knifeboy10
: Come on, SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSANA. It only hurts the first time.
: There’s an empty space not far from here.
: A place to turn the clock back.
: Your presence is requested.
: I will deliver you to the to the to the to the dream world.
: You will will will will REMEMBER TO SMILE.
: S...Sensei!...Help...me!...
scene knifeboy11
: Don’t worry, Sana! I’m here to help! And it looks like I showed up just in time!
: Sensei! You can fly?!
: Face me, evildoer! I shan’t allow the tickling of these trees! You haven’t filed for the appropriate permits!
: Yes I have.
scene knifeboy12
: Oh, okay then.
: Sorry, Sana. This is out of my hands.
: Nooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo~
scene knifeboy8
: There’s no need to cry, young one. You’ll be safer under artificial skies.
: They’ll protect you from the rain.
: You won’t ever want to leave.
: Ngh...no! This...isn’t happening! None of this...is real!
: When will you ever believe?
: Leave me...alone!
: I hope you brought your swimsuit.
: It’s time to get wet.
scene sploosh
scene knifeboy13
: If you could build your own world, what would it look like?
: Would you decorate it with your favorite colors and designs? Or would you try to create a place where everyone would be happy instead of just you?
: If it were up to me...I think I’d be selfish. But that doesn’t make me a bad person, does it?
: Everyone else would eventually get used to the colors I chose. And in a world where everyone is happy, I’m sure people would still find something to be sad about.
: Like...look at you, Sensei. If this world is as infinite as you and Ayane claim it to be, what’s stopping you from spending each and every day just having fun?
: I hope you guys are right...Life seems way easier without something to worry about. And if I could go back any time things started to go on for too long, well...
: I just think that would help keep the parts of me I’m afraid of away for longer than I’m able to do on my own.
: But, then again...
scene knifeboy14
: If that were the case, we’d never make it to that future where-
scene knifeboy15
scene knifeboy16
scene knifeboy17
Sana Sakakibara was not where she thought she was. But she never should have thought she was somewhere she wasn’t.
More things that don’t belong suddenly do. More things that do suddenly don’t. So when things become another thing they become another thing and then another and then they’re gone.
That’s where we are now — a place that isn’t on top of a place that is, full of beings who aren’t when they think that they are.
Sana Sakakibara had fallen through the map and wound up in another realm — a place where dreams come prior to sleep. But that’s only because it’s a place that sleep has not found yet.
scene knifeboy18
: Sana Sakakibara — your attendance is required for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium in four days.
: The current temperature is sixty-five degrees Fahrenheit. The time of day is to be determined shortly.
: Until then, feel free to make yourself comfortable somewhere between darkness and daytime. Refreshments will be provided momentarily.
: ...what?
: In order to replicate the critical success of “Ad Infinitum,” a familiar song will now play on repeat through the loudspeaker. Though it may not be familiar to you.
: Please take a seat on the bench and wait patiently for your number to be called. Your guide will be arriving shortly.
scene knifeboy19
She could not believe her eyes or her ears or her mouth. This was insanity. This was crazy. This was super fucking weird. It was chaos. Madness. Other negative adjectives!
There was no wind, just the faint smell of chlorine as music bounced off of expertly painted walls (or wall?) of a dome that held her like the unmoving nucleus of a cruel joke.
Right now, she was the unborn child of reality itself, wriggling and thinking on the floor of Earth’s uterus. She did not know what was approaching for the silence had already settled in.
: I’m going fucking insane.
She wasn’t. This was REAL. Super real! That’s why other people kept experiencing it! But she didn’t know that yet. She doesn’t know anything yet because she isn’t ALLOWED TO. She is SUPPRESSED.
Reach forward! Touch the walls! Feel that wet lead paint on your fingertips before bringing to your lips and painting them blue only for your skin to follow suit! Skin suit! Special Ami! She is here!
: TURN
scene knifeboy20
NEVERMIND IT’S SOMEONE ELSE OH SHIT
: Wha-
: FEAST YOUR EYES UPON MY TRUER FORM.
: I RETURN IN A REALM OF MY OWN, MORE POWERFUL THAN I WAS BEFORE. SO WHY IS IT YOU HAVE GROWN WEAKER?
: WHY HAVE YOU CHANGED? WHY ARE YOU LESS SUITED?
: Who are you?...
: And why do I keep seeing things like this?...
: I AM PEGASUS, PEERLESS GOD OF FORGIVENESS. YOU SEE ONLY WHAT YOU ARE MEANT TO SEE AND NOTHING MORE OR LESS.
: WERE YOU TICKLED BY THE TICKLER? DO YOU NEED TO BE CLEANSED? IS THAT WHY I CAN SEE YOU CLEARER THAN BEFORE????
: SPEAK, WEAK ONE. SPEAK THE WORDS YOUR WHORE MOTHER SPOKE WHEN PLUCKING FEATHERS FROM MY EIGHTH WING. DO NOT BE SWALLOWED BY THE EQUAL TASTE OF FEAR.
: I would like to go home now, Mr. Pegasus.
: YOU CAN NOT LEAVE BEFORE ATTENDING THE SYMPOSIUM. I HAVE FOUR DAYS TO LOCK YOUR HEART IN MY CAGE.
: NOW SPREAD YOUR FUCKING LEGS AND LET ME IN.
: I don’t think it will fit, Mr. Pegasus.
: YOU DON’T FEAR ME AT ALL, DO YOU?
: I don’t think I’m coherent enough to feel fear right now...
: Either that or I just fell asleep in the middle of the road.
: YOU THINK ME A DREAM, WEAKLING? YOU DARE DOUBT THE PRESENCE OF A PEERLESS ONE? DO YOU NOT UNDERSTAND HOW EASY IT WOULD BE FOR ME TO ERASE YOU?
: Do it then.
: You want something from me, don’t you?
: All of you do. That’s why you keep showing up. That’s why you keep trying to take me.
: I have something you want. But...you don’t have anything for me, do you?
: THAT IS WHERE YOU ARE WRONG, CHILD.
: ANYTHING YOU NAME SHALL BE YOURS IF YOU PLEDGE YOURSELF TO ME. YOU NEED ONLY SPREAD YOUR LEGS AND SPEAK THE WORD.
: I want my teacher to fall in love with me.
: I DON’T MAKE DEALS WITH LESBIANS.
: The other one. The one who doesn’t come to school anymore.
: If you’re saying you’ll grant me a wish, I wish for him to fall in love with me and for everyone else to give up. Can you make that happen?
: WHY HIM?
: Can you make it happen or not?
: REMOVE YOUR CLOTHING AND LIE IN THE SAND. I WILL FILL YOU WITH A FLUID YOU MAY FEED TO HIM WHEN THE TIME IS RIGHT.
: BUT DO IT QUICKLY OR-
: You shouldn’t listen to him. He’s lying to you.
scene knifeboy21
: KNIFE BOY! YOU HAVE STUCK YOUR NOSE WHERE IT DOES NOT BELONG ONCE MORE! DO NOT BELITTLE ME WHEN YOU YOURSELF CAN NOT EVEN SEE THE LIGHT.
: Hello. I will be your guide today. Are you ready for a tour of the school?
: YOU DARE IGNORE ME, SHUNNED ONE?
: I WILL NEVER FORGIVE YOU.
The two-headed horse vanishes, leaving Sana Sakakibara alone with Knife Boy, the Shunned.
But while he is here to provide a service and give her a tour of the school, Sana Sakakibara does not budge.
scene knifeboy22
Probably because she recognizes his voice and is more in shock now than she was after seeing the God of Forgiveness.
: Shota?...
: Are you ready for a tour of the school?
: Shota...
: Do you...
: Not remember me?...
: I remember you.
: How could I ever forget my sister?
scene knifeboy23
: It’s really you then?! What are you doing here?! Is this Heaven?! Are you-
scene knifeboy24
: Wait, did I die? Why can I see you?
: I’m not supposed to answer any questions that aren’t related to the tour.
scene knifeboy25
: Forget what you’re supposed to do! I’ve been hearing your voice for so long and now I actually get to see you! Also, have you really been watching me this whole time? Because that’s super creepy.
: I’m not supposed to answer any questions that aren’t related to the tour.
: What...happens if you do?
: They add a knife for every rule I break. It really hurts. Are you ready for a tour of the school now?
scene knifeboy26
: What school do you keep talking about? It’s just water and old furniture here.
: The one beneath the surface. We have to swim there.
: It’s where they’re holding the Symposium. You won’t want to miss it.
: It’s supposed to be a lot of fun this year. Several high-ranking gods from the Head Office are-
: Shota, why don’t you just take the knives out?
scene knifeboy21
: Take them out?
: Yeah. If they hurt so much, why don’t you just take them out?
: I don’t know. Maybe that’s against the rules too?
: It’d be really depressing to take one out just for another one to be added in.
: Do you want me to help?
: You probably shouldn’t. The school is really big and if you don’t get familiar with it soon, you could stay lost in there forever.
: Four days is plenty of time! Let’s talk! Actually talk! So much has happened lately and I don’t want to regret not telling you anything before I wake up!
: Mom misses you too, Shota. She still can’t even talk about what happened. But maybe if she knows you’re in here, she-
: I don’t like Mom anymore.
: ...What?
: She’s the reason I’m shunned here.
: They always talk about how she broke the rules and how much of a whore she is.
: Are you becoming a whore too, Sana? Is that why you do that thing with your fingers all the time?
: So...you have been watching.
: What does it feel like?
: Uhh...Shota? When I said I wanted to talk, I...didn’t mean about that.
: Oh. What did you mean, then?
scene knifeboy18
: Sana Sakakibara spent the next three hours talking to Knife Boy about everything that’s changed in her life.

: She even caved and confessed about how she’d been experimenting sexually lately, but wasn’t sure just how appropriate it was since she was pretty sure her brother stopped aging after death (as one does).
: Knife Boy didn’t speak much. He was worried that more sharp objects would be slid into his body.

: It was roughly thirteen minutes later that Sana decided to try and remove one. To the surprise of both of them, it came out smoothly and without pain. And no other knives appeared to take its place.
: It was a good day for Knife Boy. He could finally be freed from the constant stabbing pains that resulted from all of the times he’d been stabbed.
: And it was a good day for Sana too since she’d finally get to see her brother. Or at least...something that harbored the soul of her brother and wasn’t obscured by tools of destruction.
: He looked significantly paler since the last time she saw him. And that’s saying a lot since the last time she saw him he was literally dead.

: And I guess he still is literally dead. But he’s dead in a lively way. Maybe. It was still up in the air, but the bright side of being under a ceiling-painted sky is that the air didn’t go on forever.
: In here, there was no chance to escape. That air only moved in circles. It had nowhere else to go.
: Or at least that’s what Sana believed at first.
scene knifeboy27
But as she removed knife after knife after knife after knife from her brother’s body, she came closer to the unfortunate truth that removing all of them was a bad thing.
: Shota?...
: Shota?...Hello?...
: You’re still with me, right? You’re still there?! Shota?!
You see, without knives, there can be no Knife Boy. So the legend that kept him anchored to this realm went poof and, with it, vanished the one non-living male Sana had any amount of feelings for.
scene knifeboy28
: Shota! Say something! Please! I don’t want you to go yet!
Too late! He is gone. But the bright side is that Sana had already navigated every stage of grief that resulted from his initial passing, so this one probably wouldn’t be that bad.
scene knifeboy29
Oh?
: ...Shota?
His shell began to crack and chip as the flood pouring from his sister’s eyes encountered an imaginary beaver working at the speed of light to erect a dam near her irises.
: Is...everything okay?...
scene knifeboy30
: Are...Are you coming back to life?! Was removing the knives all it took to bring you back?! Can we get out of here together now?! Did I do a good job?!

: I can’t wait to introduce you to everyone! Ayane is amazing. And we have this whole group that plays D&D and- actually. Before I forget, stay away from Kirin. Okay? She’ll...hurt you. Let’s just say that.
scene knifeboy29
: There’s that sound again. Are you just a big, human-shaped egg? Because I thought your skin felt kind of weird, but-
scene knifeboy31
He has hatched!
scene knifeboy32
: Sensei?...
: Sensei?
scene knifeboy33
: So you’re telling me you have no idea how you got here?
: Yeah...so if you happen to know the way out-
scene knifeboy34
: Oh...no. I’m in the same boat. One minute, I was going for a walk. The next, I was getting hit on by a horse with two heads and...pulling knives out of my brother’s...ghost...thing?
: You don’t think we might’ve...died, do you?
: If we did, Heaven’s way weirder than I would have expected. Which...isn’t to say I really expect it at all. It’s just that this...has that sort of “afterlife” feel to it. You know?
: Yeah...
: You’re really sure you don’t know who I am?
: I mean...you called me “Sensei” earlier, so...maybe you’re not far off? Like...we don’t...go to school together, do we? We look about the same age, so...
scene knifeboy35
: I’m actually in high school.
scene knifeboy36
: Really?! But you look so-
: Ah! Remember to be polite when you’re speaking to upperclassmen. I might look small, but I’m actually your onee-san.
: I’m sorry! I really had no idea!
scene knifeboy37
: It’s fine. Don’t worry about it. I just don’t get many chances to tease you, so I figured I’d jump on this one.
: So you’re...really positive you know me then? In...the real world or...wherever we’re supposed to be right now.
: I do...
: And it might sound surprising hearing it like this, but...you’re actually a really important person to me.
scene knifeboy38
: You don’t have a girlfriend, do you? Want to do some experimenting with a cool onee-san?
: O-Oh...You’re one of those types of girls.
scene knifeboy39
: What do you mean “one of those” types of girls?!
: Y-You know! The kind who...do those things with...younger...
: A-Anyway! I do have a girlfriend! A really pretty one too! With...pretty eyes and...long hair and...she’s real, okay?!
scene knifeboy40
: Pfft. Sounds super believable, Sensei.
: I mean it! And stop calling me that! My name is Akira!
: Well, it’s nice to “meet” you, Akira.
scene knifeboy41
: My name is-
scene knifeboy42
: Ah.
: O, infinite spring — your song ever sweet. How intimate, poignant, and true.
: How it blurs every line, every thought that we think — and brings me right back here to you.
: Kaori?...
scene knifeboy43
: So it’s you today.
: What’s...me today? And what...happened to your eyes?
: For what reason did you stray from the two-headed horse?
: Did his elevator pitch never reach the floor of your choice?
: The...Pegasus...thing? I just thought it was creepy. But things like that...they keep showing up. And it isn’t always him, it’s-
: Is it the idea of God you despise? Or have you simply not found the right one?
: I don’t...
: Kaori...what’s going on? Where are we?...
: Are you actually here?...Or is this just another thing I’m making up right now?...
: I could ask you the same question.
scene knifeboy44
: Your wish was admirable — but your subsequent actions when saving Knife Boy leave much to be desired.
: There are some rules that must be followed at all costs. Which means that those who break those rules must be punished severely or everyone else would break them too.
: Today, you felt but a taste of what comes when you color outside of the lines.
: But I hope that, in the future, you’ll do better.
: It’d be a shame to be the one who erases you.
: Erase?...
: But what do you-
